reviews.rationale: The exact selected transcription preserves both visible main-text stars and drops only raised apparatus numerals. The English does not import rain, fertility, reward, or another witness. Humankind is a defensible inclusive equivalent for children of men, while work and toil remain distinct. Notes identify the plural object and actual critical signs without substituting variants. Medium confidence and pending-review status are appropriately bounded.

The precise candidate preserves these relations and the final age/eternity wording rather than the facing-witness alternative. Uprightness and companions are within the personally photographed lexicon ranges. There is no Ethiopic main-text star at the opening: the raised 48 is an apparatus reference. The source and note correctly avoid transferring the Greek star.
